name: 01-classico-escuro
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution landscape screenshot concept of cubeControl Mini DAW, a sober minimal desktop Windows WPF application. Straight-on flat UI only, no surrounding desk, no perspective, no glow, no bloom, no gradients, no glass, no shadows or decorative effects. Entire interface feasible with WPF UI/ModernWpf styled Grid, ToolBar, ComboBox, Buttons, Sliders, ListView and custom simple vector Canvas. Segoe UI typography, 4px corner radius, tight professional alignment. Functional muted blue/teal/purple/ochre waveform accents only. All labels Portuguese, crisp readable. Full application screenshot, not a collage.
REQUIRED: upper transport toolbar includes main audio device ComboBox 'USB Audio ASIO', red active recording indicator and Rec, Play, Stop, Loop toggle, Metrônomo; BPM slider '120 BPM', speed '1,00×', pitch stepper '+0 st'; razor-style Cortar icon, Importar and Exportar Fluent outline icons. Timeline ruler with numbered bars and Loop Cycle bracket, playhead, colored waveforms with visible split clips. Each track LEFT HEADER includes name, S M R buttons, input ComboBox, gain slider/value, simple flat small pan knob labeled Pan L/R; small drag grip/drop cue. Include empty track with dashed 'Arraste áudio aqui'. COLLAPSIBLE right playlist/download library with chevron, search, compact cards named audio files, duration and MB, preview play and direct download buttons. MIXER compact narrow vertical channel strips including master; EACH channel duplicates input selection, S M R, pan knob and gain; vertical fader directly OVER the VU meter behind its thumb, readable dB scale +6 0 -6 -12 -24 -48, numeric gain. Master includes input and pan too. No oversized mixing strips. No stock photos, no album art. Primary custom music controls are simple drawable WPF vector shapes; action icons Fluent. Do not add plugin racks or unrelated panels.
VARIANT: Dark graphite #202020 canvas, #292929 surfaces, #555555 selected header. Balanced classic layout: four audio tracks and one empty lane in upper center, full-width bottom compact mixer, playlist right. Reference concept with straightforward clean hierarchy.
